Sejam muito bem vindos ao Grupo Bringel, inovação e ousadia estão no nosso DNA.

title: Partner Marketing Director
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Partner Marketing Director role at Canonical

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Partner Marketing Director role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new leadership role, Partner Marketing Director, to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we play a unique role in a variety of innovative value chains (Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, IoT) supporting our partners both technically and commercially.
Reporting to the VP of Marketing you will lead a team of marketing managers running partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open source based products and solutions. In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.
Location: This role is home based in the AMER region.
The role entails

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue outcomes through key partners – Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, GSIs, etc.
  • Aligning with growth, field and product marketing to deliver activities integrated with Canonical's campaigns.
  • Owning the execution of partner campaigns across the funnel from recruitment to demand generation programs.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community through exceptional content in partnership with the communication, product and alliances teams.
  • Multiplying our partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Crafting bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out in the marketplace.
  • Championing our partner collaboration vision both internally and externally.
  • Managing the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF) whether we receive it or distribute it.
  • Driving the adoption of advanced analytics and reporting tools to continually improve the ROI of partner marketing activities.
  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers covering our whole spectrum of partners.
  • Cultivating a culture of continuous testing and optimization.
What we are looking for in you
  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful co-marketing programs in the technology space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities and touchpoints.
  • Ability to create a culture of excellence, agility and self-drive in your team.
  • Curiosity with a habit of continuous learning.
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional academic results both at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we are looking for in you
  • Familiarity with a particular vertical (e.G. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive).
  • Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence;
in order to succeed, weneed to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: B2b Marketing Insights Director
description:
Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub! We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

Opportunity

We are hiring a B2B Marketing Insights Director to our Marketing team in São Paulo, Brazil !

We are looking for a Director of B2B Marketing Insights Analysis to act as a strategic partner to the Marketing team, leveraging data to drive growth, influence demand generation, and maximize revenue. This role is the bridge between our data and business leaders, moving our team from reactive to proactive and data-driven approach. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, capable of understanding business challenges and analyzing data to tell a story that drives insights and action, translating complex analyses into compelling business narratives that optimize marketing performance and ROI.

Your Impact
  • Lead and manage the B2B marketing analytics/technical team, fostering their development and ensuring alignment with company objectives.
  • Lead the discovery of deep, localized insights from granular data to drive targeted initiatives and inform strategic decisions.
  • Act as a strategic partner in cross-functional forums with the Sales team, ensuring strong alignment between marketing initiatives and sales objectives to accelerate the pipeline.
  • Develop and deliver executive-level reports on demand generation and growth KPIs, providing actionable insights for senior leadership.
  • Define and unify B2B marketing funnel concepts (e.G., Traffic, Lead, MQL, Opportunities, Cost per Lead) to measure performance and its impact on revenue growth.
  • Oversee the development of dashboards and reports, applying data governance best practices to ensure data integrity.
  • Evaluate and implement marketing analytics tools and technologies (e.G., Tableau, Google Analytics, Salesforce) to support the B2B marketing funnel.
  • Leverage AI-driven insights and discussions for campaign optimization, multi-touch attribution modeling, or other B2B crucial initiatives to maximize marketing ROI.
  • Lead the B2B data budget and planning cycle, partnering with global business leaders to define targets and with the Data Strategy team on forecasting methodology.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.
Qualifications
  • Previous relevant years of progressive experience in marketing or overall analytics within a B2B SaaS environment, with experience in a leadership/management role.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Analytics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong experience in data analysis and interpretation.
  • Solid grasp of the B2B lead-to-revenue funnel, including key metrics, lead scoring, and attribution models.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker), web analytics (Google Analytics, Amplitude), and the MarTech ecosystem (Salesforce, HubSpot).
  • Proven ability to influence strategy through data storytelling.
  • Strong leadership, proactivity, and the talent to translate complex data into compelling insights for diverse audiences.
  • Fluent English is mandatory.
  • Familiarity with AI use cases in B2B problems and AI/ML models.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. For this specific role, prior experience in marketing analytics within a B2B SaaS environment, managing and leading teams and advanced English are mandatory requirements.

What we offer you

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

  • WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.
  • WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. The Work You'll Do

At Sovos, we're looking for an exceptional Principal UX Designer to join our team as the strategic owner of our design system and design operations. This is a unique individual contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of visual design excellence, systems thinking, and technical implementation, ready to set the standard for design across our entire organization.

As the design system owner, you will be the cornerstone of design consistency and innovation across all our products. You'll work at the forefront of design-to-code initiatives, establishing processes that transform how our design and development teams collaborate. This role offers the rare opportunity to shape design culture, drive strategic decisions, and influence product experiences at scale, all while staying hands-on with the craft you love.

More specifically, you will:

  • Own and evolve our design system strategy, applying atomic design principles to create scalable, maintainable component libraries that serve as the foundation for all product experiences
  • Drive design system adoption and excellence by creating comprehensive documentation, establishing usage standards, and implementing quality assurance processes that ensure consistent, high-performing implementation across all teams
  • Lead the design-to-code transformation by partnering with development leadership to establish seamless workflows from Figma to production, positioning our organization at the forefront of modern design operations
  • Set design standards and accountability measures by auditing design work, identifying improvement opportunities, and working with UX directors to ensure teams maintain the highest standards of component usage and design consistency
  • Identify and integrate emerging design trends by staying current with industry patterns, evaluating new approaches, and strategically incorporating innovations that enhance our design system without disrupting established workflows
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment by communicating complex design decisions clearly, training teams on new patterns, and ensuring successful rollout of design system updates across the organization
What We Need From You
  • 8+ years of experience in UX/product design with significant focus on design systems, component libraries, and design operations within enterprise SaaS environments
  • Proven design system ownership with experience managing atomic design principles, maintaining component libraries, and successfully rolling out system updates across multiple teams
  • Strong technical foundation including understanding of CSS, component frameworks (like Bootstrap), React concepts, library versioning, and design-to-code workflows
  • An exceptional portfolio demonstrating design system work that shows both strategic thinking and meticulous execution, visual design excellence with keen attention to modern trends, clear documentation of complex design decisions, and examples of successful cross-functional collaboration
  • Experience as a systems thinker who understands atomic design principles deeply and has successfully managed design systems at scale
What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

  • Flexible Time-Off
  • Meal Vouchers to assist with food expenses
  • Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days
  • Globally recognized Training and Development programs
  • Virtual English Club through Rosetta Stone, and more!

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos' cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries -- including half the Fortune 500 -- trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

description:
We are ARVORE, a startup in the virtual reality content creation scene. Our process emphasizes teamwork, agility, and multidisciplinarity. We are looking for a passionate and self-motivated person with a positive attitude and a genuine team player, who likes to share knowledge and is open to learning from others. We embrace problem solvers, those who aren't afraid to experiment and fail, and are ready to create something new.

ARVORE is looking to hire a technically adept, creative individual to complement our team. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavors.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Creative Directors are responsible for defining and nurturing the product’s vision, understanding the company’s strategic goals, and keeping everyone’s efforts focused towards the same direction.

Always aligned with the Production Manager and the Head of Studio, Creative Directors are responsible for defining and constantly reviewing the scope to keep projects on budget and on time.

This work also requires establishing the foundations of the experiences in all three pillars (artistic, systems, and narrative). The Creative Directors will articulate their vision, fostering an environment of collective creativity that inspires the team to come up with the best ideas, choosing the ones that fit into a coherent whole.

MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES:
  1. Define a clear and reasonable creative vision for the product.
  2. Work closely with the Core Team members to develop their specific parts of the vision, tying together all artistic and technical elements.
  3. Constantly review the priorities and scope of each product delivery and/or milestone together with the Product Manager, considering the Value Proposition and goals of the product, but at the same time championing the product’s unique vision.
  4. Review production timelines, budget, and team performance with the Product Manager.
  5. Nurture and communicate the overall creative direction on an ongoing basis, inspiring the team through leadership.
  6. Be aware of internal and external QA results to direct creative decisions, ensuring the product meets main stakeholders' needs.
  7. Guarantee the consistency and quality of the product, ensuring creative cohesion between the user experience and company strategy.
  8. Serve as the spokesperson for the product’s vision within the team, for the press, and corporate management.
MUST HAVE:
  • Experience in a creative leadership position on at least one high-quality professional entertainment product/property shipped or delivered in industries such as XR, Games, Movies, Television, Advertisement, or Comics.
  • Positive leadership qualities.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to listen and communicate effectively (spoken and written).
  • Fluency in English.
  • Understanding and sensitivity to capturing the spirit of the moment (Zeitgeist).
  • Deep understanding of current trends in XR, gaming, and entertainment industries, influencing user expectations and behaviors.
  • Huge curiosity and openness to research and expand knowledge in virtual reality games, narratives, immersive art, etc.
NICE TO HAVE:
  • Familiarity with Google G Suite, Monday, Slack, and Github.
  • Fluency in Portuguese.
  • Previous experience with VR and AR content is desirable.
  • A passion for Games, Movies, TV, Art, Animation, Electronics, RPGs, Literature, Theater, Popular Culture, and narrative experiences.
  • Knowledge of other project management techniques.
  • Experience in a technology or content development environment.

title: First Marketing Hire / Marketing Lead
description:
Join to apply for the First Marketing Hire / Marketing Lead role at Avra .

About Avra

Avra is a deep tech platform powered by foundational AI that translates the complexity of SMBs (Small and Medium Businesses) into strategic decisions for large enterprises.

We develop our own foundational models from the ground up—without relying on third-party solutions—to deliver innovative insights that empower some of the leading enterprises across Latin America.

Today we focus on three main areas: (1) boosting underwriting by increased recommended credit limits and reduction in delinquency;
(2) increasing enterprise revenue through hyper-personalization of offerings to SMBs;
and (3) customer segmentation to attract the right kind of SMBs to the sales funnel.

Founded in 2024 by Viviane Meister and Bruno Alano (ex-OpenAI) and accelerated by NVIDIA, AWS and Google.

The Role

This role is for a marketer who loves translating complex technical products into crisp clarity. You’ll shape how a new made-in-Brazil AI model positions itself with C-Suite and Leaders at top-tier Brazilian companies. You'll be the voice that makes a complex product extremely simple to understand - and a critical force behind our Go To Market strategy.

As our first Marketing hire, you will be pivotal in creating awareness of what we do while accelerating our B2B growth with the right customers.

This is both a strategic and hands-on position, all in Avra style. You will work at a high level: defining our market narrative, positioning our product, adapting as our strategy evolves. And you will get your hands dirty: building creative mock-ups, coordinating events for clients, running our social media platform and working as the company's PR arm.

The ideal candidate must have B2B / enterprise experience.

Responsibilities
  • Marketing strategy & execution for a new brand in a new segment. You will be running the marketing ship independently, as our first and only marketer. Basically, we want you in the arena, owning all marketing efforts for Avra.
  • Understand our customers to define and adapt our Product Marketing: you will work closely with Product, Sales and Customer Services to understand what our product does, who our purchasers are, how can make it simple to understand and adopt Avra so our marketing fits accordingly. You will draft compelling messaging, support with strategic sales tools (e.G., pitch decks) and support new product launches.
  • Generate influential marketing content: You will define and be the voice of Avra. You will manage a content strategy that establishes Avra as a thought leader in the AI, fintech and model building space (coordinating blog posts, case studies, leadership articles, whitepapers) in line with our Build in Public strategy.
  • Drive visibility of Avra brand to the right audiences. Use your existing network, build a network and work with our third party PR partner to drive Avra's presence in media outlets and events. Organise and be present at Avra events to drive successful outcomes.
  • Own our website and all our social media platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram).
  • Own marketing performance & data: take full ownership of marketing KPIs. From the marketing funnel (# leads, numerical assessment of lead quality, conversion, acquisition cost), engagement (brand awareness, success of our communications). You will manage the marketing budget.
  • Market intelligence: stay on top of industry trends and the competitive landscape.
  • Design and deliver petit-comité events tailored for our enterprise clients. You will ensure the experience feels high-touch, personalized and relevant. You will craft the event narrative, coordinate logistics, and engage directly with participants to strengthen relationships and showcase Avra’s value.
What We're Looking For
  • Builder mindset: Strong bias for action. Self-starter who thrives with autonomy. You roll up your sleeves to deliver best-in-class work.
  • And one step further: a segment builder mindset: we're building a model from the ground up with many different potential applications. You are comfortable with ambiguity and ask the right questions
  • A narrative generating machine: you will influence our positioning strategy
  • An AI evangelist: you are interested in AI, use it in your work already, and want to learn more
  • Out of the box and creative maker: you're not afraid of pulling together mock-ups of ideas. You are a creative thinker that can materialise your vision.
  • Great relationship builder: you will work seamlessly with our third parties (design, public relations), and suppliers to facilitate work like event organisation
  • You are comfortable with data: you talk about marketing with numbers, not just qualitatively. And you use data to make decisions.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to manage stakeholders and deliver executive presentations.
Requirements
  • Experience: 4-5 years work experience
  • Industry: experience in B2B SaaS marketing - specially enterprise. A background in a fast-paced, early-stage startup environment is a significant plus.
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field is great but not required. We care about your track record.
  • Languages: Portuguese & English fluency

title: Principal Ux Designer
description:
Join to apply for the Principal UX Designer role at Sovos

Build your future with Sovos.
If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges -- we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes -- apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the 'right' resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere;
it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do

At Sovos, we're looking for an exceptional Principal UX Designer to join our team as the strategic owner of our design system and design operations. This is a unique individual contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of visual design excellence, systems thinking, and technical implementation, ready to set the standard for design across our entire organization.

As the design system owner, you will be the cornerstone of design consistency and innovation across all our products. You'll work at the forefront of design-to-code initiatives, establishing processes that transform how our design and development teams collaborate. This role offers the rare opportunity to shape design culture, drive strategic decisions, and influence product experiences at scale, all while staying hands-on with the craft you love.

More Specifically, You Will
  • Own and evolve our design system strategy, applying atomic design principles to create scalable, maintainable component libraries that serve as the foundation for all product experiences
  • Drive design system adoption and excellence by creating comprehensive documentation, establishing usage standards, and implementing quality assurance processes that ensure consistent, high-performing implementation across all teams
  • Lead the design-to-code transformation by partnering with development leadership to establish seamless workflows from Figma to production, positioning our organization at the forefront of modern design operations
  • Set design standards and accountability measures by auditing design work, identifying improvement opportunities, and working with UX directors to ensure teams maintain the highest standards of component usage and design consistency
  • Identify and integrate emerging design trends by staying current with industry patterns, evaluating new approaches, and strategically incorporating innovations that enhance our design system without disrupting established workflows
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment by communicating complex design decisions clearly, training teams on new patterns, and ensuring successful rollout of design system updates across the organization
What We Need From You
  • 8+ years of experience in UX/product design with significant focus on design systems, component libraries, and design operations within enterprise SaaS environments
  • Proven design system ownership with experience managing atomic design principles, maintaining component libraries, and successfully rolling out system updates across multiple teams
  • Strong technical foundation including understanding of CSS, component frameworks (like Bootstrap), React concepts, library versioning, and design-to-code workflows
  • An exceptional portfolio demonstrating design system work that shows both strategic thinking and meticulous execution, visual design excellence with keen attention to modern trends, clear documentation of complex design decisions, and examples of successful cross-functional collaboration
  • Experience as a systems thinker who understands atomic design principles deeply and has successfully managed design systems at scale
What Does Sovos Offer You?
  • Flexible Time-Off
  • Comprehensive Health benefits
  • Meal Vouchers to assist with food expenses
  • Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days
  • Mentoring Programs
  • Globally recognized Training and Development programs
  • Virtual English Club through Rosetta Stone, and more!

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos' cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries -- including half the Fortune 500 -- trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates.

title: Head Of Brand - Brasil
description:
Job Description

Location: São Paulo, Brasil

Type of contract: Full time

About Luzia

Luzia is LATAM’s fastest-growing consumer AI company, backed by world-class investors including Khosla Ventures, A*, Monashees, Prosus and Sequoia. Our mission is to redefine what conversational AI can do by leveraging cutting-edge large language models (LLMs) and advanced alignment techniques to create intuitive, human-like digital assistants.

Just two years after launch, Luzia is already woven into the daily lives of millions of Brazilians. We’re now deepening our roots here at home, bringing even more local flavor and warmth to everything we build. Join us and help shape Luzia’s voice and product for Brazil from day one.

The Role

As our Head of Brand in Brazil, you’ll build on Luzia’s existing brand foundation and bring it to life locally, adding the cultural nuance and emotional depth that resonates with Brazilian users. You’ll craft a distinctive, human brand presence that feels both consistent with our global identity and uniquely relevant to the local market. You’ll lead the charge in shaping how millions of people experience and connect with Luzia, working cross-functionally to build a brand that drives love, loyalty, and organic growth — positioning Luzia as the most trusted and beloved AI assistant in one of our most important markets.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and define Luzia’s brand in Brazil— identity, and voice to reflect the cultural context, emotional tone, and everyday realities of our Brazilian audience.

  • Create emotional connections with users— craft narratives, campaigns, and experiences that go beyond utility and build lasting emotional bonds with millions of users.

  • Champion brand consistency— ensure a unified voice and visual identity across all touchpoints: product, marketing, tech, and talent.

  • Manage Public Relations and storytelling efforts— partner with Brazilian agencies and internal teams to build earned local media strategies and tell stories that resonate with both mainstream and underserved communities.

  • Collaborate across teams— work hand-in-hand with product, growth, comms, and design to bring brand ideas to life and make sure everyone internally is aligned around a clear brand mission.

  • Translate insight into impact —lead research efforts on market positioning, user sentiment, and competitive dynamics in Brazil, acting as the closest voice to our users and ensuring their needs, culture, and perspective shape brand decisions at every level.

  • Use content and influencers as strategic tools— partner with local creators, ambassadors, and users to grow organic reach and relevance.

  • Drive organic brand growth — focus on strategies that scale awareness and engagement through word-of-mouth, content, SEO, and product-led storytelling — not just paid media.

  • Manage budgets and agency partners— oversee brand-related investments, including agency collaborations ensuring high return and aligned execution.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strategic brand builderwho’s done this before in Brazil— ideally in a high-growth consumer tech company or strong brand-led startup.

  • Deep experience in brand, mobile, and PR— you know what it takes to launch and scale brand presence in the Brazilian market.

  • A strategic operator— able to zoom out and set long-term direction, while also rolling up your sleeves to execute or manage projects day-to-day.

  • Stay deeply connected to our audience— read comments and reviews, engage directly with users, and immerse in the behaviors, trends, and desires of Brazilian young adults to continuously adapt our messaging and brand voice.

  • Obsessed with the user— you’re constantly engaging with users and deeply in tune with Gen Z and Millennials, our core audience. You draw insight from their behaviors, language, and culture to craft brand experiences and messaging that genuinely resonate.

  • A storyteller at heart— with a gift for creating narratives that spark curiosity, trust, and emotion.

  • Fluent in visual and emotional branding— with strong creative sensibility and the ability to direct top-tier brand work.

  • Collaborative to the core— able to inspire teams, work across functions, and align stakeholders behind the brand vision.

  • Analytically sharp and resource-savvy— focused on high-impact, measurable initiatives and able to prioritize what moves the needle.

  • Tuned-in to Gen Z & Millennials— you intuitively speak their language, tap their cultural cues, and craft experiences that land with Brazil’s digital-native generations.

  • AI-savvy experimenter— eager to explore, question, and ship breakthrough AI features that put cutting-edge tech directly in users’ hands.

  • Fluency in English is required;
    Spanish is a plus.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working at a tech startup or fast-scaling mobile app in Brazil.

  • Track record of working closely with product and growth teams to align brand and user experience.

  • Ability to balance instinct and data — you know when to trust the numbers and when to lead with bold intuition.

Why Join Luzia?

At Luzia, you’ll help shape one of the most exciting consumer AI products in the world. We move fast, stay humble, and keep users at the center of everything we do. If you're passionate about AI, thrive in dynamic environments, and want your work to impact millions of people, we’d love to meet you.

Our Culture & Values

We’re builders at heart — driven by data, experimentation, and velocity. Our team lives by a “ship, learn, iterate” mentality, constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. At Luzia, autonomy meets accountability in an environment where ideas win and learning never stops.

Your Impact

In this role, you won’t just be building a product — you’ll be helping define a category. The work you do will shape how millions of people interact with AI every day, and help chart Luzia’s course in one of our most important markets.

Para chegar lá, investimos acima de tudo nas nossas pessoas, que formam um time incrível e comprometido com esse grande objetivo. E aí, vem com a gente?

Nossa cultura

Nossos valores são a base para tudo que fazemos! Aqui na Unico, agimos sem fronteiras;
impactamos sem rodeios;
somos transparentes mesmo em situações difíceis;
resilientes e adaptáveis para evoluir;
fazemos a coisa certa do jeito certo e somos ousados ao liderar a construção do futuro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é descontraído e colaborativo, cheio de oportunidades de aprendizado e possibilidades para você desenvolver sua carreira com autonomia e apoio de líderes e colegas.

Missão : Buscamos uma pessoa Product Designer com alto nível de senioridade para atuar de forma estratégica e “mão na massa” no desenvolvimento de novas iniciativas da Unico. Essa pessoa terá um papel fundamental na construção de produtos com alto grau de inovação, colaborando com áreas estratégicas e contribuindo diretamente para elevar a régua de qualidade do time de Design .


O que você fará/será responsável por:

Experiências:

Auxíliohome office: valor mensal de R$ 120,00 para pagamento de contas e consumo;

Na Unico estamos empenhados em construir uma cultura inclusiva, valorizando em todas as nossas posições a candidatura de todas as pessoas, independentemente de sua etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, política, religião, deficiência, naturalidade ou qualquer outro tipo de característica.

title: Head Of External Relations
description:
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

OKX is seeking a strategic and execution-driven professional to lead its external relations strategy in Brazil. This role is designed to focus on engagement with legislators, executive branch officials, trade associations, industry leaders, and other key stakeholders — playing a central role in shaping how digital assets are understood and integrated into Brazil’s economic landscape.

As Head of External Relations , you will report directly to the CEO of OKX Brazil and act as a key voice for the company’s local strategy and institutional reputation. While the role will support regulatory engagement when aligned with broader market initiatives, the core mission is to represent OKX in Brasília, São Paulo, and across Brazil’s institutional ecosystem — bringing clarity, data, and constructive dialogue to advance the role of crypto in the country’s economy.

The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of Brazil’s institutional and economic landscape with a passion for innovation and financial transformation. You’ve successfully engaged with decision-makers in Congress, executive agencies, trade bodies, and organizations such as the Free Market Institute. You are proactive, persuasive, and comfortable operating in institutional, economic, and media-facing environments.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Lead OKX Brazil’s government engagement strategy, building trusted relationships with legislators, senior government officials, and political institutions.
  • Represent OKX in political and public policy discussions, including in congressional hearings, forums, industry roundtables, and institutional meetings.
  • Monitor and interpret legislative developments, flagging risks and opportunities while aligning with internal teams on positioning and responses.
  • Help craft OKX Brazil’s public narrative through thought leadership, speaking engagements, and written contributions that support the company’s strategic priorities.
  • Partner with legal and compliance teams to ensure that regulatory interactions are consistent with broader government engagement goals.
  • Build alignments with other market participants and advocacy organizations to advance shared interests and protect the integrity of the local crypto market.
  • Serve as a key spokesperson for OKX in Brazil’s policy ecosystem, echoing the company's mission to be a responsible, constructive, and long-term player in the local economy.
What We Look For in You
  • Residents of São Paulo with strong experience navigating the local political and legislative environment.
  • 10+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, or political advisory roles — ideally within financial services, technology, or a highly regulated sector.
  • Proven track record of engagement with legislators, ministries, and policy-focused organizations.
  • Strong communication and advocacy skills — able to influence, inform, and build credibility with diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a global, fast-paced, and high-growth environment.
  • Strategic thinker with sound judgment, political awareness, and strong execution capabilities.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (spoken and written).

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX\ 's Candidate Privacy Notice.

We also offer benefits and programs such as L&D and Education subsidies, team-building events, wellness and meal allowances, and comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependents.

More that we love to tell you along the process!

Please note: This role requires fluency in both Portuguese and English to effectively collaborate with internal and external stakeholders. It also requires a hybrid work model with regular in-office presence.

Lar das marcas de higiene, saúde e nutrição mais amadas e confiáveis do mundo. Este cargo tem foco em análise de mercado, gestão de negócios e identificação de tendências, sendo responsável por impulsionar o crescimento sustentável das marcas através de decisões baseadas em dados e insights de mercado.

A nossa equipe comercial ajuda a cumprir o propósito da Reckitt, construindo sucesso compartilhado com nossos clientes, possibilitando acesso à higiene, bem-estar e nutrição da mais alta qualidade possível nas lojas e online.

Suas Responsabilidades
  • Liderar o fluxo de operating model interno para a categoria de bem-estar íntimo.
  • Suportar o desenvolvimento estratégico do plano anual e de longo prazo de marcas.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de marketing baseadas em análise de dados e inteligência de mercado.

A Brasil Paralelo
Liberdade. Busca pela Verdade. Ambição. Meritocracia. Beleza e Arte. Estes são alguns dos valores de nossa empresa. Criamos obras que impactaram a vida de milhões de pessoas - obras em que resgatamos nossa história, tão maltratada, em que tocamos na ferida da educação, e em que apresentamos com sobriedade temas delicados, produzindo alguns dos documentários mais assistidos do Brasil.
Nossa Missão:
Resgatar os bons valores, ideias e sentimentos no coração de todos os brasileiros.
Nossa Visão:
Ser o Ecossistema de maior influência cultural do Brasil.
Sobre a cultura da Brasil Paralelo:
Nossos valores não são virtudes de vitrine vestidas à força em quem só quer trabalhar, mas a verbalização das atitudes que nos levaram a ser o que somos. Liberdade. Busca pela Verdade. Ambição. Meritocracia. Beleza e Arte. Estes são alguns dos valores de nossa empresa. Criamos obras que impactam a vida de milhões de pessoas, em que apresentamos com sobriedade temas delicados, produzindo alguns dos documentários mais assistidos do Brasil.
1 - Verdade: A Verdade não é relativa, é o bem maior e uma meta inesgotável. Segue-se que não há espaços seguros, pois para pensar você precisa arriscar ofender. Na contramão de boa parte das empresas modernas, aqui não há discriminação ideológica contra libertários e conservadores. Não há desrespeito à sua inteligência. Não há novilíngua. Não se precisa pisar em cascas de ovos. Não há patrulha de pensamento. Não há privilégio da ortodoxia.
2 - Liberdade: Os indivíduos são diferentes na hora de escolher, agir e colher resultados, e tolher sua liberdade é abuso de poder. Incentivamos o desenvolvimento da consciência de ser responsável pelos resultados, e valorizamos quem consegue se auto motivar para trabalhar e aprender com autonomia.
3 - Arte: Tudo que não for possível assimilar pela linguagem racional, será comunicado e sentido pela arte bem-feita. Vemos na criação audiovisual uma oportunidade de encontro entre tecnologia e arte. Acreditamos que o uso de ferramentas inovadoras, aliados à busca constante pela beleza, é o norte que nos guia em nossa missão.
4 - Ambição : Quem almeja a máxima perfeição em suas conquistas, por mais que nunca a alcance, sempre dará o seu melhor. Estamos aqui para construir produtosque virem referência e sejam tudo que possam ser.
5 - Meritocracia: Todos nós queremos o melhor da vida e o melhor do mundo, e a única forma legítima de conquistarmos isso é com o mérito. Toda a conquista sem mérito é instável e passageira. Por isso, fazemos o esforço deliberado de recompensar melhor os que fazem melhor em vez de aceitar uma equidade que primeiro desanima alguns para depois se espalhar aos demais.
6 - União: Somos todos diferentes por aqui, não apenas fisicamente, mas em ideias e perspectivas. É preciso saber a hora de preterir nossas diferenças e preferir nosso objetivo em comum, pois juntos podemos fazer o que sozinho seria impossível. É uma questão de sobrevivência nos unir, e é uma questão de responsabilidade pela nossa missão sobreviver.
7 - Diplomacia: Ser diplomático é ser humilde. Respeitar as pessoas é lembrar que não somos donos da verdade, e de que sozinhos não somos capazes de construir o mundo em que vivemos. Ser diplomático não é ser falso, pelo contrário, é se entrosar no mundo em vez de separarmo-nos dele.

O Head de Marketing será responsável por liderar todas as estratégias de marketing da empresa, com foco em visibilidade, engajamento de clientes e crescimento sustentável. title: Gerente De Agência De Viagens
description:
Planejar, organizar e supervisionar as operações da agência de viagens, assegurando a excelência no atendimento ao cliente, a rentabilidade do negócio e a inovação constante nos serviços turísticos oferecidos.

1. Gestão Operacional e Comercial

- Supervisionar as equipes de atendimento, vendas e suporte técnico, assegurando desempenho alinhado às metas da agência.

- Garantir a execução eficiente e padronizada dos processos operacionais, como reservas, emissões, cancelamentos e reembolsos.

- Monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), propondo ações corretivas e estratégias de melhoria contínua.

- Desenvolver e implementar campanhas promocionais e comerciais que impulsionem o faturamento e ampliem a base de clientes.

2. Relacionamento com Clientes e Fornecedores

- Atender diretamente clientes estratégicos e corporativos, buscando a resolução ágil de demandas com foco em satisfação e fidelização.

- Negociar com operadoras, companhias aéreas, redes hoteleiras e demais fornecedores, buscando as melhores condições comerciais e operacionais.

- Implantar e supervisionar políticas de atendimento baseadas na excelência, no relacionamento humanizado e na personalização da experiência do cliente.

3. Gestão Financeira

- Acompanhar o fluxo de caixa, o faturamento e as despesas operacionais, assegurando o equilíbrio econômico da operação.

- Elaborar relatórios financeiros e orçamentários periódicos, propondo medidas de ajuste e otimização de recursos.

- Monitorar e gerenciar inadimplências, garantindo a saúde financeira da agência.

4. Inovação e Tecnologia

- Acompanhar as tendências do mercado turístico, incluindo inovações tecnológicas e mudanças no comportamento do consumidor.

- Avaliar e implantar soluções tecnológicas como sistemas GDS (Global Distribution Systems), OTAs (Online Travel Agencies) e CRMs para aprimorar a gestão de viagens e o relacionamento com o cliente.

- Incentivar a digitalização de processos internos e a presença estratégica da agência nos meios digitais, ampliando sua competitividade.

title: Consultor Ou Consultora De Corporate Finance
description:
Overview

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Somos a EY-Parthenon , a consultoria estratégica da EY! Ajudamos nossos clientes a criar estratégias personalizadas e a colocá-las em prática. Como parte de nossa equipe, você atuará dando consultoria em sintonia com as necessidades específicas de cada cliente e ajudando a impulsionar a vantagem competitiva deles, contribuindo para a construção de um mundo de negócios melhor.

#EYP

Por que você?

Como um(a) Consultor ou Consultora de Corporate Finance você assumirá as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Análise das demonstrações financeiras de Empresas, incluindo análise de indicadores financeiros (liquidez, endividamento, rentabilidade), análise vertical/horizontal;
  • Análise macroeconômica e de drivers e tendências para diversos segmentos de mercado;
  • Modelagem econômico-financeira para diversas finalidades, incluindo projeções alavancadas, construção/revisão da taxa de desconto, construção do racional de receita para diversos tipos de negócios, classificação de custos/despesas como fixo/variável, cálculo de depreciação, cálculo de dias de capital de giro e da variação da necessidade de capital de giro, cálculo de impostos diretos e indiretos para diferentes regimes tributários (simples, presumido, lucro real), fechamento de saldos do balanço patrimonial projetado, análises de sensibilidade;
  • Suporte na elaboração de relatórios de valuation e apresentações executivas;
  • Suporte em projetos de M&A na elaboração long list de potenciais compradores e/ou targets, elaboração de materiais de mercado (teaser / memorando informativo), controle contatos do go-to-market, organização da due dilligence, entre outros;
  • Suporte em projetos de captação de dívida incentivada e/ou estruturada via mercado de capitais.

Por que você?

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Engenharias, Estatística, Matemática ou Direito.
  • Experiência em FP&A e/ou Finanças Corporativas (Valuation, M&A, etc);
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento intermediário do Pacote Office.

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Conhecimento em Phyton e/ou em análise de dados e IA generativa;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Inglês e Espanhol;
  • Experiência prévia em consultorias ou boutiques de M&A.

O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Multibenefícios, Vale Transporte, Plano de Saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Universidade Corporativa, Patrocínio em MBA e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Acesse go.Ey.Com/beneficios e conheça nosso universo de benefícios .

Job Title: Medical Science Liaison

About This Role: As a Medical Science Liaison (MSL), you will be a pivotal member of the Medical Affairs team, responsible for engaging with Key Medical Experts (KMEs), Healthcare Professionals (HCPs), and other relevant stakeholders. Your role is to foster trusted relationships and provide unbiased scientific information that supports Biogen’s clinical and medical strategies. You will proactively engage with customers, tailoring discussions to meet their unique needs while aligning with Biogen’s vision to advance medical practice in neuroscience. Through dynamic and compliant interactions, you will capture valuable medical insights that shape clinical strategies. Your expertise will position you as a partner in the medical community, influencing long-term relationships and driving Biogen’s reputation as a leader in the field.

What You’ll Do:

  • Establish yourself as a trusted partner to KMEs and HCPs, delivering credible medical and scientific information.
  • Engage proactively with customers, addressing their needs while pivoting conversations to relevant topics.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships, developing scientific advocates within the medical community.
  • Capture and report high-value medical insights to inform Biogen’s clinical strategies using Veeva.
  • Collaborate compliantly with cross-functional teams, particularly with the Commercial organization.
  • Lead complex educational activities that enhance Biogen’s reputation as a valued partner.
  • Stay updated on therapy advances and current research related to Biogen’s products and disease areas.
  • Apply extensive knowledge of disease areas and competitive environments to contribute to brand planning.
  • Navigate industry compliance guardrails to empower interactions with stakeholders.
  • Travel extensively to engage with customers and deliver impactful scientific exchanges.

Who You Are:
You are a proactive and dynamic professional with a passion for scientific exchange and patient care. Your ability to tailor discussions to meet individual needs, combined with your medical business savvy, makes you a credible partner to healthcare professionals. You thrive on building long-term strategic relationships, always acting within compliance guardrails. Your curiosity and active listening skills help you capture valuable insights, contributing to Biogen's mission to advance neuroscience. You are flexible and adaptable, ready to navigate complex situations and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Required Skills:

  • Advanced Scientific or Clinical degree (Master's required;
    PharmD or PhD preferred).
  • At least 1 year of experience as a Medical Science Liaison.
  • Proficiency in English;
    advanced (fluent preferred).
  • Ability to travel at least 60% of the time, including overnight and occasional weekend travel.
  • Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in neuroscience or related fields.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Based in northeast of of Brazil, Preferable Fortaleza or Recife.

Job Level: Management
Why Biogen?

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.

At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. A mineradora é a indústria mais longeva do país, com 190 anos de atuação, e uma das maiores produtoras de ouro do Brasil. Com cerca de 3 mil empregados diretos, as operações brasileiras estão entre as mais avançadas do mundo no campo da tecnologia de mineração, pela excelência dos equipamentos e processos utilizados e pelo desenvolvimento de soluções de engenharia foco em segurança e na prática de uma mineração responsável no subsolo.

Na AngloGold Ashanti, acreditamos que a diversidade é uma força transformadora. Estamos comprometidos em revolucionar o setor da mineração, promovendo um ambiente onde cada pessoa seja valorizada por sua singularidade, com a equidade e a inclusão como pilares fundamentais de nossa cultura.

Como parte desse compromisso, atuamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de gênero no setor e avançar na construção de um futuro mais justo e sustentável.

  • Desejável conhecimento no módulo SAP Ariba.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Representar a área de Suprimentos nas operações, sendo ponto de conexão e interação entre Operações e de Suprimentos.
  • Liderar as operações de almoxarifado, incluindo gestão das operações de posto de combustível e paiol de explosivos, dos sites Cuiabá/Lamego e Queiroz.
  • Controle de estoque, armazenamento, logística e atividades de remessa com foco no controle de custos, além de melhorar a eficiência e a precisão no gerenciamento de estoque e da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Responsável por comportamentos consistentes com a Missão, Visão e Valores da AngloGold Ashanti.
  • Promover uma cultura de Saúde e Segurança entre os colaboradores.
  • Contribuir para a Excelência Operacional, proporcionando melhorias de desempenho sustentáveis por meio de liderança, disciplina e processo.
  • Garantir a conformidade com as práticas legais e de compliance em sua área de responsabilidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter relações de trabalho eficazes com todos os stakeholders locais e regionais.
  • Monitorar se todas as políticas, procedimentos e orientações emitidas pela administração do site relevante são cumpridas.

  • Auditar o inventário de estoque do almoxarifado para garantir que o processo de retirada de estoque seja concluído até o final do ano civil, de acordo com os requisitos financeiros e da SOX.
  • Gerenciar as atividades do almoxarifado para fornecer o nível de serviço otimizado para fornecer os recursos de que a empresa precisa para atingir suas metas.
  • Estabelecer e monitorar procedimentos de armazenamento e manuseio.
  • Responsável por identificar e recomendar oportunidades para otimizar a utilização de frete e logística para cada site.
  • Gerenciar e coordenar provedores logísticos terceirizados, incluindo agentes de agenciamento de cargas internacionais.
  • Responsável por desenvolver e gerenciar os orçamentos (Budget) de Capex, operação e pessoal relativos aos almoxarifados dos sites.
  • Identificar e desenvolver melhorias de processo para processos e sistemas de logística, estoque e armazém a partir de uma visão regional.
  • Implementar processos e sistemas globais de estoque e almoxarifado da AGA.
  • Suportar no gerenciamento e coordenação do processo de planejamento da produção, incluindo previsão de oferta/demanda, gerenciamento de estoque e entrega no prazo.
  • Implementar e executar as melhores práticas na gestão da área.
  • Garantir que os padrões de gestão e organização dos almoxarifados estejam alinhados aos padrões globais da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Responsável por garantir um relacionamento eficaz com todas as demais funções de Suprimentos dentro da região, ou seja, cadastro de materiais e fornecedores, gestão de inventário e materiais, melhoria da cadeia de suprimentos e governança.
  • Responsável por auxiliar e suportar os aspectos de gestão de contratos e contratadas, sendo a interface de Suprimentos entre todos os contratos gerenciados globais e regionais e a entrega ao negócio.

A AGA estimula a candidatura de profissionais com perfis diversos em todas as nossas vagas. Promovemos a inclusão de mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, reabilitados do INSS, pessoas negras, membros da comunidade LGBTQIA+ e profissionais de todas as idades em nossos processos seletivos. Esperamos sua inscrição!

O grupo AngloGold Ashanti tem sede em Londres (Reino Unido), e atuação em nove países, com 10 operações. Empresa de capital aberto, suas ações são negociadas nas bolsas de Johannesburgo, Nova York, Austrália e Gana. No Brasil, a empresa possui minas e plantas metalúrgicas e de beneficiamento nos estados de Minas Gerais e Goiás.

Somos exemplo de cuidado ativo e de segurança, nosso primeiro valor. Trabalhamos com disciplina e excelência operacional, buscando a inovação e a melhoria contínua para manter nossas operações entre as mais avançadas no setor da mineração. O nosso trabalho é pautado na mineração responsável e no compromisso com as pessoas, com o meio ambiente e com o desenvolvimento sustentável.

Temos responsabilidade e orgulho de valorizar a multiplicidade de perspectivas e experiências que a diversidade proporciona, seja ela baseada em gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, deficiência, formação cultural, religião ou idade.

title: Head Of Brand - Brasil
description:
Job Description

Location: São Paulo, Brasil

Type of contract: Full time

About Luzia

Luzia is LATAM’s fastest-growing consumer AI company, backed by world-class investors including Khosla Ventures, A*, Monashees, Prosus and Sequoia. Our mission is to redefine what conversational AI can do by leveraging cutting-edge large language models (LLMs) and advanced alignment techniques to create intuitive, human-like digital assistants.

Just two years after launch, Luzia is already woven into the daily lives of millions of Brazilians. We’re now deepening our roots here at home, bringing even more local flavor and warmth to everything we build. Join us and help shape Luzia’s voice and product for Brazil from day one.

The Role

As our Head of Brand in Brazil, you’ll build on Luzia’s existing brand foundation and bring it to life locally, adding the cultural nuance and emotional depth that resonates with Brazilian users. You’ll craft a distinctive, human brand presence that feels both consistent with our global identity and uniquely relevant to the local market. You’ll lead the charge in shaping how millions of people experience and connect with Luzia, working cross-functionally to build a brand that drives love, loyalty, and organic growth — positioning Luzia as the most trusted and beloved AI assistant in one of our most important markets.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and define Luzia’s brand in Brazil— identity, and voice to reflect the cultural context, emotional tone, and everyday realities of our Brazilian audience.

  • Create emotional connections with users— craft narratives, campaigns, and experiences that go beyond utility and build lasting emotional bonds with millions of users.

  • Champion brand consistency— ensure a unified voice and visual identity across all touchpoints: product, marketing, tech, and talent.

  • Manage Public Relations and storytelling efforts— partner with Brazilian agencies and internal teams to build earned local media strategies and tell stories that resonate with both mainstream and underserved communities.

  • Collaborate across teams— work hand-in-hand with product, growth, comms, and design to bring brand ideas to life and make sure everyone internally is aligned around a clear brand mission.

  • Translate insight into impact —lead research efforts on market positioning, user sentiment, and competitive dynamics in Brazil, acting as the closest voice to our users and ensuring their needs, culture, and perspective shape brand decisions at every level.

  • Use content and influencers as strategic tools— partner with local creators, ambassadors, and users to grow organic reach and relevance.

  • Drive organic brand growth — focus on strategies that scale awareness and engagement through word-of-mouth, content, SEO, and product-led storytelling — not just paid media.

  • Manage budgets and agency partners— oversee brand-related investments, including agency collaborations ensuring high return and aligned execution.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strategic brand builder who’s done this before in Brazil— ideally in a high-growth consumer tech company or strong brand-led startup.

  • Deep experience in brand, mobile, and PR— you know what it takes to launch and scale brand presence in the Brazilian market.

  • A strategic operator— able to zoom out and set long-term direction, while also rolling up your sleeves to execute or manage projects day-to-day.

  • Stay deeply connected to our audience— read comments and reviews, engage directly with users, and immerse in the behaviors, trends, and desires of Brazilian young adults to continuously adapt our messaging and brand voice.

  • Obsessed with the user— you’re constantly engaging with users and deeply in tune with Gen Z and Millennials, our core audience. You draw insight from their behaviors, language, and culture to craft brand experiences and messaging that genuinely resonate.

  • A storyteller at heart— with a gift for creating narratives that spark curiosity, trust, and emotion.

  • Fluent in visual and emotional branding— with strong creative sensibility and the ability to direct top-tier brand work.

  • Collaborative to the core— able to inspire teams, work across functions, and align stakeholders behind the brand vision.

  • Analytically sharp and resource-savvy— focused on high-impact, measurable initiatives and able to prioritize what moves the needle.

  • Tuned-in to Gen Z & Millennials— you intuitively speak their language, tap their cultural cues, and craft experiences that land with Brazil’s digital-native generations.

  • AI-savvy experimenter— eager to explore, question, and ship breakthrough AI features that put cutting-edge tech directly in users’ hands.

  • Fluency in English is required;
    Spanish is a plus.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working at a tech startup or fast-scaling mobile app in Brazil.

  • Track record of working closely with product and growth teams to align brand and user experience.

  • Ability to balance instinct and data — you know when to trust the numbers and when to lead with bold intuition.

Why Join Luzia?

At Luzia, you’ll help shape one of the most exciting consumer AI products in the world. We move fast, stay humble, and keep users at the center of everything we do. If you\ 're passionate about AI, thrive in dynamic environments, and want your work to impact millions of people, we’d love to meet you.

Our Culture & Values

We’re builders at heart — driven by data, experimentation, and velocity. Our team lives by a “ship, learn, iterate” mentality, constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. At Luzia, autonomy meets accountability in an environment where ideas win and learning never stops.

Your Impact

In this role, you won’t just be building a product — you’ll be helping define a category. The work you do will shape how millions of people interact with AI every day, and help chart Luzia’s course in one of our most important markets.

description:
Gerente de Agricultura Regenerativa Cadeia de fornecimento de óleo de palmaGerente de Agricultura Regenerativa Cadeia de fornecimento de óleo de palma

Gerente de Agricultura Regenerativa Cadeia de fornecimento de óleo de palma

Trabalhamos com os nossos membros e parceiros para tornar as cadeias de valor um motor de prosperidade para comunidades e ecossistemas, operando diretamente nos territórios. Vemos um mundo no qual as florestas são uma fonte ilimitada de materiais e um lar para a biodiversidade, as comunidades têm direitos respeitados e oportunidades de se desenvolver, os trabalhadores são parceiros produtivos, e a agricultura se torna o instrumento para alimentar um planeta faminto e manter o clima estável.

Sobre o Projeto Carbono

Localizado na Microrregião Tomé-Açu (PA), tem o objetivo de implementar práticas de baixo carbono, na cadeia de produção de óleo de palma de uma empresa local. Por meio de uma abordagem de ambientação climática, visa a gerar reduções e remoções de carbono por meio de quatro intervenções principais: (i) Estabelecimento de Sistemas Agroflorestais (SAFs), (ii) Restauração de áreas degradadas, (iii) Plantio de cultivo intercalar de cacau e palmeira, (iv) Transição para fertilizantes de base orgânica.

Como Gerente de Projetos, você será o(a) principal responsável por:

  • O Gerente de Projeto em Agricultura Regenerativa será responsável pelo planejamento e execução do Plano de Trabalho alinhado à estratégia de Landscape da microrregião de Tomé-Açu, incluindo gestão orçamentária e entrega de metas.
  • Além disso, o(a) gerente será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de diagnósticos, linhas de base e relatórios técnicos, bem como pela liderança na implementação de projetos de agricultura regenerativa, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos e metas estabelecidas. Também atuará na facilitação de capacitações para as equipes da Earthworm Foundation e parceiros, apoiando agricultores na adoção de práticas como sistemas agroflorestais (SAFs) e fertilização orgânica, com foco na redução e remoção de carbono.
  • Sob a supervisão do Líder de Campo, o gerente atuará como principal ponto de contato com parceiros do projeto , incluindo empresas e agricultores, promovendo engajamento contínuo e comunicação clara entre as partes.
  • O(a) gerente também será responsável por organizar visitas técnicas, workshops e eventos de campo, oferecendo suporte logístico e administrativo. Caberá ainda o monitoramento do progresso do projeto por meio da análise de dados, elaboração de relatórios periódicos e sistematização de aprendizados. Espera-se a entrega de estratégias, projetos e protocolos internos desenvolvidos, além da capacitação das equipes e da atuação dos agricultores com práticas regenerativas conforme o planejado.

Condições de trabalho

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciências Agrárias, Engenharia Ambiental ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência: Mínima de 3 anos
  • Idioma(s): Português e Inglês/Espanhol
  • Contrato temporário: 1 ano – Regime CLT (44 horas semanais)
  • Local: Microrregião Tomé-Açu (PA

Você tem as características que buscamos? Confira:

Buscamos uma pessoa proativa e comprometida com resultados, para atuar na cadeia de suprimentos de óleo de palma em Tomé-Açu (PA), com foco na redução de carbono e práticas agrícolas sustentáveis. É importante ter boa comunicação e engajamento com stakeholders, contribuindo para a regeneração de paisagens e a sustentabilidade da região.

Experiência com agricultura sustentável, agroflorestas, fertilização orgânica, restauração de ecossistemas e conhecimento em geoprocessamento são diferenciais. Também valorizamos habilidades de liderança para apoiar agricultores na adoção de práticas de baixo carbono e paixão por agricultura regenerativa.

Se está procurando um propósito e deseja inovar e agir pelo meio ambiente, esta oportunidade é para você! Na Earthworm Foundation , você se juntará a uma equipe comprometida e apaixonada, focada em encontrar soluções concretas. E também descobrirá diversas personalidades, todas determinadas a regenerar ecossistemas.

Se tem interesse nessa aventura, inscreva-se enviando o seu Currículo para nossa equipe no Brasil, aos cuidados de Raquel Costa – - 24/06/2025 , com o assunto "Regenerative Agriculture Manager – 2025".

title: Head De Marketing
description:
Sobre a vaga

Você é um líder de marketing com visão estratégica, espírito empreendedor e capacidade de construir marcas fortes com base em dados, experiência do cliente e inovação digital? Essa oportunidade é para você.

Sobre a Unifisa

A Unifisa é uma administradora nacional de consórcios, reconhecida pelo Banco Central do Brasil e associada à ABAC, com mais de 30 anos de mercado. Nosso propósito é claro: transformar vidas e impulsionar negócios. Como parte do Grupo Unifisa, atuamos nos segmentos de seguros e locação de veículos. Agora, com foco em consolidar nossa atuação como um ecossistema de soluções financeiras inteligentes e personalizadas, buscamos um líder de marketing preparado para contribuir com essa nova fase de crescimento.

Sobre a oportunidade

Você será responsável por liderar a transformação estratégica da marca Unifisa — da comunicação à experiência do cliente. Seu papel será garantir que o marketing seja uma alavanca real de crescimento, conversão, fidelização e expansão da marca como um hub completo de soluções financeiras.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Desenvolver e executar o plano estratégico de marketing 360º, com foco em crescimento sustentável, reconhecimento de marca e aceleração digital.
  • Liderar projetos de branding, conteúdo, mídia paga, inbound marketing, SEO/SEM, CRM e automação, integrando canais on e offline.
  • Gerar impacto direto no funil de vendas: aumentar geração de leads qualificados, reduzir CAC e elevar conversão.
  • Conduzir iniciativas para personalização da jornada do cliente, aumento do IF3 (índice de confirmação da terceira parcela), redução de churn e fidelização ativa.
  • Estabelecer rituais de integração estratégica entre marketing, comercial e CX, com metas compartilhadas.
  • Implementar práticas de análise preditiva, segmentação e inteligência de dados, contribuindo para decisões mais assertivas.
  • Fortalecer a presença digital da Unifisa com iniciativas de conteúdo, SEO, redes sociais e mídia de performance.
  • Gerenciar o time interno e agências externas com foco em execução ágil, criativa e orientada a resultados.
  • Acompanhar os KPIs estratégicos da área: ROI, CAC, CPL, LTV, NPS, engajamento e conversão.
Perfil que buscamos
  • Formação superior completa em Marketing, Comunicação, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de marketing em empresas de serviços financeiros, fintechs, consórcios ou modelos B2C com forte presença digital.
  • Domínio de marketing de performance, funil de aquisição, CRM, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Analytics, automação e UX.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma estratégica, criativa e analítica, com domínio de growth, jornada do cliente e inteligência de mercado.
  • Liderança forte, visão sistêmica, pensamento ágil e facilidade em conduzir projetos multidisciplinares com autonomia.

Desejável (não Eliminatório)

  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou especialização em Marketing Estratégico, Digital Business, Growth ou Customer Experience.
  • Conhecimento em design de jornada, squads ágeis, UX/UI, Open Finance ou ecossistemas financeiros.
  • Experiência com gestão de CRM, CDP, plataformas digitais e construção de comunidades.
O que você vai encontrar aqui
  • Autonomia para liderar uma área estratégica em fase de reposicionamento e crescimento.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e horizontal, com liberdade para inovar, testar e criar do zero.
  • Participação em projetos com forte potencial de visibilidade e impacto direto nos resultados do grupo.

REQUISITOS

  • Reconhecimento real por performance, inovação e entrega de valor.
  • Local de trabalho: São Paulo, SP.
  • Regime de contratação de tipo: Prestador de Serviços (PJ).
  • Jornada: Período Integral.
  • Nível hierárquico: Gerente.

HABILIDADES

  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal
  • Boa comunicação
  • Habilidades desenvolvidas para negociação

  • Convênio odontológico
